connection.toolRefresh: works: Claude Code picked up the editor tool list after newProject/openProject and the home list after closeProject
connection.tokenStorage: plaintext Authorization header in ~/.claude.json (adapter recommends keychain via the bridge)

time.snapNote: move to 0.0123 s landed on 0.016667 (1/60); caption times re-snap to the 60 fps grid on reload

stableIdsNote: UUIDs persist across saveProject/closeProject/openProject. No name/label/metadata field on elements. Reconcile must keep an EDL-id -> UUID map in the project folder. splitCaption (and presumably split/splitClip) replaces the element with new UUIDs.

captions.timingsNote: captions() returns phrase start/end plus tokens without per-word times; Edits holds word times internally (splitCaption at 6.0 snapped to the word gap 6.26/6.32)
captions.editNote: editCaption rewrites a phrase in place; tokens keep originalText and record editedText

segmentation.result: masked overlay of the clip on a new top track
segmentation.verdict: unusable for behind-head: the mask is a single still frame; correct on the first frame, wrong once the head moves

alphaNote: Both imported with addOverlay, composited over the base and over a text placed between; transparent area showed base and text, opaque area hid the text, in captureFrame and in the export.
overlayNote: A 1080x1920 file on an overlay track at scale 1 fills the canvas exactly like the base clip. Same setTransform (scale 1.6, x 0.55, y 0.6) on base and overlay = identical framing, no double edge (checked at 50% opacity, both for a duplicate and for a separately imported file, preview and export).

stacking.order: tracks() lists bottom to top; main track is index 0
stacking.newTrackDefault: addOverlay and addStickerFromCutout create a new track on top
traps: duplicate(placement=newTrackSameTime) inserts its track directly above the main track, below existing texts
addText reuses any overlay track with free time (the probe text landed on the captions track); use moveToLayer to fix order

export.async: export returns at once; poll exportStatus (state exporting -> complete); 12 s timeline took ~30 s

paramTraps: addOverlay: scale must be in (0, 1]; set larger zoom afterwards with setTransform
setTransform: keyframes is required and must be reject | offsetAll | clear; allowBeyondCanvas is required
addMedia is audio only; use importMedia for video
generateCaptions source must be video | voiceover | importedAudio | all
setTransforms takes items as a JSON string
forbiddenNote: No share/publish/schedule/upload tool is exposed in this build. Any tool with that purpose that appears later is forbidden without explicit per-video approval.
gaps: No name/metadata field on elements: reconcile needs an EDL-id -> UUID map file
Caption word timings are not exposed, only phrase start/end
Native segmentation is a still-frame mask; behind-head needs matte.py alpha layers
Text box width is fixed: long words at large sizes wrap onto two lines (seen at size 90)
HEVC alpha cannot be checked with ffprobe here (alpha shows as None); Edits composites it correctly
